jobs.occupation: Chartering Broker (f/m/d) – Regional Trade & Project Cargo (Intra-Europe) (Schifffahrtskaufmann/-frau - Trampfahrt)
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Briese Chartering is an established Shipowner/Carrier based in Leer/Germany managing a modern and versatile fleet of short-sea and multipurpose (MPP) vessels ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 DWT with a strong focus on carriage of project cargo. For further information see: www.briese-chartering.com (http://www.briese-chartering.com/)   We are seeking an experienced Chartering Broker to join our Intra-Europe Regional Trade desk. In this role you will hold commercial responsibility for maximizing the utilization and profitability of our owned and controlled tonnage. You will optimize vessel loops across Europe, securing high-yielding regional breakbulk and specialized project cargo stems by maintaining direct relationships with industrial charterers, shippers and project forwarders.Negotiate charter parties directly with cargo owners and competitive brokers, protecting the company's commercial interests. Fleet Optimization & Chartering Fix our 3,000–10,000 DWT fleet on Voyage Charters and Contracts of Affreightment (COAs) across European trade routes (Baltic, North Sea, Continent, Mediterranean/Black Sea and North/West Africa). Optimize vessel routing and scheduling to minimize ballast days and maximize daily time charter equivalent returns.Project Cargo & Voyage Estimation Evaluate and price specialized project cargo inquiries tailored to our vessels' capabilities. Perform precise voyage calculations including bunker tracking, port/terminal expenses, and laytime analysis to ensure optimal margins. Market Integration & Collaboration Leverage the north/central European shipping community while managing an active network of international chartering contacts. Work closely with our in-house operations and technical management teams in Leer to guarantee smooth post-fixture execution. Qualifications & Experience  Essential Criteria - Minimum 3 years of commercial experience on the owner’s side or with an exclusive broker specifically within the European short-sea or small-MPP sectors. - Solid understanding of 3k–10k DWT vessel capabilities including stowage configurations, deck strength and regional port/canal restrictions. - Deep knowledge of European trades including seasonal weather factors, ice clauses and short-sea port operations. - Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German is highly preferred given our regional hub and team integration. Core Skills - Commercial drive with a clear focus on asset P&L and strategic fleet positioning. - Proficiency in voyage estimation and other standard software tools (MS Office, Sedna, Netpas, etc.). - Existing network of direct project cargo clients, industrial shippers and European forwarders.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Verhandlungsführung, Wirtschaftlichkeitsberechnung, SchifffahrtsrechtExpertenkenntnisse: Befrachtung

jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Scientist for Attosecond and Structured X-ray FEL R&DRemuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years | Start: 01.06.2027 | ID: MMA060/2026 | Deadline: 25.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-timeDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The European XFEL is one of the world's leading free-electron laser facilities, providing intense X-ray pulses with durations down to the attosecond regime. Further development of existing capabilities and exploration of novel approaches are pursued within the joint virtual FEL R&D group of DESY and European XFEL. The position focuses on the development of advanced FEL schemes for generating and controlling attosecond and structured X-ray pulses, with particular emphasis on orbital angular momentum (OAM) and the manipulation of temporal, spectral, and transverse radiation properties. The work combines theoretical studies, numerical simulations, and experimental demonstrations at the European XFEL. The successful candidate will also have opportunities to develop and pursue new ideas for advanced X-ray pulse generation and control.About your role:- Develop and optimize novel FEL schemes for attosecond and structured X-ray pulse generation, particularly OAM and advanced attosecond XFEL concepts- Perform numerical simulations of electron-beam dynamics and FEL radiation using codes such as with international research partners, and contribute to the development of new FEL conceptsAbout you:- University degree in physics, accelerator physics, or a closely related field- Strong background in free-electron laser physics, accelerator physics, or a related area, with a good understanding of FEL processes and electron-beam dynamics- Experience with numerical simulations of FELs or particle accelerators, preferably using established simulation tools- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international and interdisciplinary research environment- Experimental experience at an XFEL or ariofher accelerator-based photon facility, including beam studies or commissioning activities- Previous involvement in research on attosecond X-ray pulses, orbital angular momentum, structured X-ray radiation, or other advanced FEL concepts- Experience in analyzing and interpreting FEL experimental data and comparing results with numerical simulations- Familiarity with FEL simulation codes such as GENESIS, Puffin, or SIMPLEX, and with advanced methods for manipulating the temporal, spectral, or transverse properties of X-ray pulses- Good written and spoken English communications skills, German is an advantageGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus.
